title: Deep investigate persistent orbit scene-off flicker
objective: Deeply investigate the fresh live render output at examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation. The user reports scene_off_flashlight_on is still flickery/bright like before after the latest stabilization. Inspect RGB PNG frames, depth NPY/viridis frames, MP4s if useful, metadata.json, frame timestamps, scene_light_state, deterministic capture metadata, and compare scene_on_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, and scene_on_flashlight_on. expected_outputs: Findings-first investigation with numeric luma/depth evidence, representative frame paths, metadata observations, root-cause hypotheses ranked by evidence, and concrete next implementation steps.
